new.heading: New invoice
new.hasDraft_one: This visit has a draft invoice. Continue it instead of making a second bill of the same work.
new.hasDraft_other: This visit has {{count}} draft invoices. Continue one instead of making another bill of the same work.

detail.heading: Invoice
detail.locked: Invoice {{number}} was issued on {{time}} and can no longer be changed.
detail.draftReadOnly: This draft can be changed by someone who may create invoices.

charges.heading: Pending charges
charges.description: Work posted to this visit that is not on a bill yet. Leave off what should not be billed now.
charges.empty: No pending charges on this visit.
charges.tooMany: Only the first {{count}} charges can go on one bill. Issue this one, then bill the rest.

flag.service_archived: Service no longer offered: last price

line.heading: Other lines
line.description_hint: Something not in the price catalog. It is priced here, by hand.
line.tooMany: A bill holds at most {{count}} typed lines.
line.descriptionHint: For example, a copy of the records.
line.unitPriceHint: In the hospital's currency, with a point for the decimals: 12.50
line.priceInvalid: Type an amount with a point for the decimals, such as 12.50.

list.heading: Invoices
list.description: Every invoice of the hospital, newest first. Find one by its number, the patient's name or MRN.

print.title: Invoice {{number}}
print.notPrintable: Only an issued invoice can be printed.

refused.chargeUnavailable: A charge on this bill was billed or taken by another draft meanwhile. The list has been read again: check it and try again.
refused.notDraft: This invoice was issued meanwhile and can no longer be changed.
refused.conflict: Someone else changed this draft. It has been read again; your choices are kept, so check them and try again.
refused.empty: Put at least one line on the bill.
refused.cancelled: This visit was cancelled and has nothing to bill.

payment.heading: Payments
payment.amountHint: Up to {{due}}, what is still due. Less is a part payment.
payment.referenceHint: A card slip, UPI or bank reference. Optional. Never a full card number.

refused.overpayment: That is more than is still due. The balance has been updated.
refused.no_open_register: Cash goes into a cash register session, and you have none open.
refused.invoice_not_payable: This invoice cannot take a payment.

refund.heading: Refund a payment
refund.amountHint: Up to {{held}}, what that payment still holds.
refund.reasonHint: Why the money is returned. Kept with the refund.
refund.amountTooMuch: More than that payment still holds.

refused.refund_exceeds: That is more than the payment still holds. The payments have been read again.
refused.no_open_register: A cash refund comes out of a cash register session, and you have none open.

credit.heading: Credit notes
credit.none: No credit note has been issued.
credit.void: This invoice is void: it was credited in full ({{credited}}).
credit.refundFirst: Money has been paid on this invoice. Refund it before a credit note can be issued.
credit.amountHint: Up to {{left}}, what is not yet paid.
credit.amountHintWhole: Up to {{left}}, what is not yet paid. The whole invoice makes it void.
credit.reasonHint: Why the invoice is credited. Shown on the credit note.

refused.credit_exceeds: That is more than is left of the invoice. It has been read again.
refused.refund_first: Money has been paid on this invoice. Refund it first.
refused.invoice_not_creditable: This invoice cannot take a credit note.

addCharge.heading: Charge a service
addCharge.description: A service of the price catalog, at the price list price in effect. It is posted to this visit as a pending charge.

refused.service_archived: This service is no longer offered. Choose another.
refused.no_price: This service has no price in effect. Set its price in the price catalog first.
refused.service_not_found: This service no longer exists. Choose another.
refused.encounter_cancelled: This visit was cancelled and has nothing to bill.
